objectives: Replace single indicator profitability chasing with per-asset/per-session cost-adjusted research arbitration against CASH and simpler controls
Compound only one continuously self-financed reconciled account (not several backtests' independent capital)
Preserve original M9/M10 N9-S NO_GO; no extra strategies, signals, seeds, economic accounts, paper/live orders, merge/deployment or recursive activation

operational_session_sources.semantic_rule: Exchange calendar confirms when trading is scheduled; never labels any hour profitable. Use America/New_York DST and exchange-provided early close/holiday calendars. Options need contract-specific verified eligibility; no overnight equity orders assumed.

prespecified_hypothesis_bundles.question: Does measured opening-range continuation after fully published first 30m improve net OOS economic growth versus cash and conventional broad-market momentum?
prespecified_hypothesis_bundles.falsification: If familywise paired lower net growth minus all costs <=0 or adverse fills above bound, reject; no more indicator tuning.

prespecified_hypothesis_bundles.question: Are BTC/ETH net return-per-risk opportunities materially different in independently preregistered UTC sessions once spread, impact and weekend availability are included?
prespecified_hypothesis_bundles.falsification: If net OOS difference across independent market days is not positive, collapse to CASH or common baseline.

prespecified_hypothesis_bundles.question: Does the put/call volatility asymmetry paired to the actual underlying, option spread and executable chain produce positive net economic value in the same eligible contract hours?
prespecified_hypothesis_bundles.falsification: If exact options contract multiplier, quote/underlying clocks, liquidity or first-cross/executable fills missing, STOP. No option orders in this branch.

causal_and_economic_guards.ranking: Only observed, time-ordered, pre-registered familywise-corrected paired OOS lower bound > round-trip costs + impact + uncertainty and relative CASH >0 may appear in read-only ranking.
causal_and_economic_guards.familywise: Consider at most six pre-registered variants. No recursive search, no reuse of final holdout, no retrospective threshold choice.
causal_and_economic_guards.instrument: No synthetic training result may be represented as live profitable evidence.
causal_and_economic_guards.compounding: From one reconciled physical financed book, W_(t+1)=W_t+grossEconomicPnL_t-tradingFees_t-externalCosts_t; receipts known before next funding; external deposits/withdrawals forbidden for simple return product. No resetting 20k or aggregating separate accounts as if fungible.
causal_and_economic_guards.settled_capital: Reinvestable headroom constrained by observed settled cash - commitments - unsettled cash - reserve and original hard capital 20k; do not let compound profit alter the original capital limit in frozen N9-S.
causal_and_economic_guards.risk: Max risk <=0.25% and gross admission <=12% at decision; never impose 12% continuous cap or liquidation.
causal_and_economic_guards.sessions: NYSE/Cboe hours are trading permission boundaries, NOT independently observed statistically optimal return windows. Crypto UTC windows are investigation buckets only. Price/calendar-only rules never grant broker authority.
causal_and_economic_guards.options: Research-only until contract-specific session and true exercise/settlement/fees/reachable execution are verified.

amendmentR2.reason: Implement bounded capital growth objective rather than ranking gross hit frequency; no observed parameter fitting or market account trial performed
amendmentR2.caps: min(0.5*f_Kelly, available gross admission/capital, remaining per-entry risk/loss upper/capital, 12% gross original, half bounded worst loss)
amendmentR2.fail_closed: Unverified source reachable fill or independently bounded loss tail rejected; binary law not a universal market distribution
